description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain, measured in percentage, of three different language models (GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL) under two different supervision conditions: strong and weak. The vertical axis represents the performance gain, with a scale ranging from 0 to 30 percent, and the horizontal axis lists the three language models. The chart includes two sets of bars for each model, one representing strong supervision and the other weak supervision. The strong supervision bars are patterned with diagonal lines, while the weak supervision bars are solid. The GPT-4o model shows the highest performance gain under strong supervision, with a value close to 30 percent, and a lower gain under weak supervision, around 5 percent. Claude-3.5-Sonnet has a performance gain of approximately 10 percent under strong supervision and about 5 percent under weak supervision. Qwen2-72B-VL has a performance gain of around 15 percent under strong supervision and approximately 5 percent under weak supervision. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
